title: JSON Outline Schema
description: Core JSON Outline Schema (JOS): a work (outline) and a flat list of items whose tree is expressed through `parent` + `order`. This schema is intentionally lenient about legacy value types (numeric strings for `indent`/`order`) because real HAXcms data contains both; writers SHOULD emit the canonical form described in each property. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express (unique ids, parent references, cycles, unique slugs) are enforced by scripts/validate.js.

id.description: Unique identifier for this work in the universe of all works. HAXcms generates a UUID v4.

title.description: Name of the work as a whole.

license.description: License short-hand for the work as a whole. HAXcms resolves the Creative Commons short-hands listed here to names/links; other values are passed through untouched.

metadata.description: Open-ended container for anything else. Core JOS defines no structure here; downstream systems (HAXcms: see haxcms-site.schema.json) layer conventions on top.

items.description: Flat array of outline items. Hierarchy is expressed by `parent`, sibling order by `order`. HAXcms re-sorts this array into depth-first tree order on every save, so readers MAY rely on array order for saved files but MUST NOT require it.

integerLike.description: Canonical form is an integer. Numeric strings ("0", "2") are accepted for compatibility with older HAXcms data.

item.title: JSON Outline Schema item
item.description: A single leaf / page in the outline. HAXcms only persists the properties listed here: any other top-level key on an item is silently DROPPED on load/save (JSONOutlineSchema.validateItem). Put extra data in `metadata`.

id.description: Unique id of the item within this outline. HAXcms uses `item-<uuid v4>`; skeletons use bare UUIDs. Treat as opaque.

title.description: Title to display for this item.

description.description: Short description of the item (HAXcms auto-fills this from the first text of the page).

parent.description: `id` of the parent item, or null for a top-level item. Canonical form is null; an empty string is accepted because it is the HAXcms in-memory default.

order.description: Sort weight relative to siblings that share the same `parent`. Canonical form: 0-based integer, contiguous within a sibling group.

indent.description: Visual indentation level. Canonical form: integer equal to the item's depth in the tree (0 = top level). Consumers SHOULD derive hierarchy from `parent`, not from `indent`; it is a display hint that can drift.

location.description: Relative path to the resource holding this item's content. HAXcms convention: `pages/<id>/index.html`.

slug.description: URL path segment(s) for this item, relative to the site base. May contain `/` (HAXcms with pathauto builds `parent-slug/child-slug`). Must be unique within the outline. Must not start with `/`.
